human: How do I reset my password?
response: Go to Account Settings, choose Security and select Reset Password. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address.

human: I never received the password reset email.
response: Check your spam folder first. If it is not there, confirm the email address on your account and request a new link after five minutes.

human: How can I track my order?
response: Open the Orders page and select the order. The tracking number and the latest carrier status are shown at the top.

human: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
response: Please send us a photo of the damaged item and the packaging within 14 days. We will arrange a replacement or a full refund.

human: What is your refund policy?
response: Unused items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days.

human: Can I return an item without the receipt?
response: Yes. We can look up the purchase with your order number or the card used for payment.

human: How do I cancel my subscription?
response: Open Billing, select your plan and choose Cancel Subscription. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.

human: I was charged twice this month.
response: Sorry about that. Please share the last four digits of the card and the dates of both charges so we can refund the duplicate.

human: How do I update my billing address?
response: Go to Billing, then Payment Methods, and edit the address associated with your card.

human: The app crashes when I open it.
response: Please update to the latest version, restart your device and try again. If it still crashes, send us the error code shown on screen.

human: What does error code 403 mean?
response: Error 403 means your account does not have permission for that action. Ask your workspace administrator to grant access.

human: I cannot log in to my account.
response: Make sure Caps Lock is off and try resetting your password. If your account is locked, it unlocks automatically after 30 minutes.

human: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
response: Open Security settings, choose Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code with an authenticator app.

human: I lost access to my authenticator app.
response: Use one of your backup codes to sign in. If you have none, contact support to verify your identity and recover the account.

human: How do I change the email on my account?
response: Go to Profile, edit the email field and confirm the change from the link sent to the new address.

human: Do you offer phone support?
response: Phone support is available on business plans from 9 am to 6 pm on weekdays. All other plans can use chat and email.

human: How long does shipping take?
response: Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping arrives within one to two business days.

human: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
response: You can change the address until the order is packed. Open the order and choose Edit Delivery Address.

human: My discount code is not working.
response: Check the expiry date and the minimum order value. Codes cannot be combined with other promotions.

human: How do I download my invoice?
response: Invoices are available on the Billing page. Select the invoice and click Download PDF.

human: Is my warranty still valid?
response: Products have a two-year warranty from the delivery date. Enter the serial number on the warranty page to check its status.

human: How do I file a warranty claim?
response: Submit the claim form with the serial number, a description of the fault and the proof of purchase. We reply within two business days.

human: The device will not turn on.
response: Charge it for at least 30 minutes with the original cable, then hold the power button for ten seconds to force a restart.

human: How do I connect the printer to Wi-Fi?
response: Press the wireless button on the printer, then select your network in the setup app and enter the password.

human: My internet connection keeps dropping.
response: Restart the router, move it away from other electronics and check whether the issue happens on a wired connection too.

human: How do I delete my account?
response: Go to Privacy settings and choose Delete Account. This permanently removes your data after a 14-day grace period.

human: Can I export my data?
response: Yes. Under Privacy settings choose Export Data and we will email you a download link within 24 hours.

human: How do I add a team member?
response: Open Team settings, click Invite and enter their email address. They will receive an invitation to join the workspace.

human: Why was my payment declined?
response: Payments are usually declined because of an expired card, insufficient funds or a bank security check. Please contact your bank or try another card.

human: Where can I find the user manual?
response: The user manual is available in the help center under Documentation, and as a PDF on the product page.

human: How do I open a support ticket?
response: Visit the help center, click Contact Us and fill in the form. You will receive a ticket number by email.

human: How can I check the status of my support ticket?
response: Sign in to the help center and open My Tickets to see the status and the latest replies.

human: The website is very slow.
response: Try clearing your browser cache or using another browser. You can also check our status page for ongoing incidents.

human: Can I upgrade my plan in the middle of the month?
response: Yes. The upgrade takes effect immediately and you only pay the prorated difference for the rest of the month.

human: Do you ship internationally?
response: We ship to more than 40 countries. Import duties and taxes are calculated at checkout.

human: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
response: Click the unsubscribe link at the bottom of any marketing email, or turn off newsletters in Notification settings.

human: The item I received is different from what I ordered.
response: We apologise for the mix-up. Please reply with your order number and a photo of the item, and we will send the correct product.

human: How do I reset the device to factory settings?
response: Open Settings, choose System, then Reset, and confirm Factory Reset. This erases all data on the device.

human: My account was hacked.
response: Reset your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication. Contact support so we can review recent activity and secure the account.

human: Can I get a refund for a digital purchase?
response: Digital purchases can be refunded within 14 days if the content has not been downloaded.

human: How do I sync my data across devices?
response: Sign in with the same account on each device and turn on Sync in the settings menu.

human: The battery drains very quickly.
response: Lower the screen brightness, close background apps and check the battery usage screen for apps using the most power.

human: What payment methods do you accept?
response: We accept major credit cards, debit cards, PayPal and bank transfer for annual plans.

human: How do I report a bug?
response: Use the Report a Problem option in the app menu and include steps to reproduce the issue and a screenshot if possible.

human: Can I pause my subscription?
response: Yes, subscriptions can be paused for up to three months from the Billing page.

human: How do I change the language of the app?
response: Open Settings, select Language and choose your preferred language. The app restarts to apply the change.

human: My package shows delivered but I did not get it.
response: Check with neighbours and your building reception. If it is still missing after 48 hours, contact us and we will open an investigation with the carrier.

human: How do I recover a deleted file?
response: Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the file and choose Restore.
